title: Ontario OESP 2026: Hydro Bill Credit and Free Upgrades
desc: Ontario's OESP takes a monthly credit off your electricity bill. Income limits rose March 1, 2024. See how it pairs with free Energy Affordability upgrades.
h1: Ontario Hydro Bill Help 2026: OESP and Energy Affordability
badge: Monthly credit on your hydro bill
lead: Ontario has two programs for lower-income households. The Ontario Electricity Support Program, called OESP, takes a monthly credit off your hydro bill. The Energy Affordability Program gives free home upgrades. Here is what the official pages say, and what they do not.
cards_heading: What we found for Ontario heating help
cards_intro: Each card names the official page we read on October 21, 2026. Dollar amounts are the government's own; anything it does not publish, we do not show.

cards.title: OESP monthly credit
cards.note: A monthly credit applied right on your electricity bill. The amount depends on how many people live in the home and your combined after-tax household income.

cards.title: Energy Affordability Program
cards.note: Free upgrades such as insulation, draft proofing, thermostats and, for oil-heated homes, cold-climate heat pumps, for income-qualified households.

sections: What OESP does

OESP lowers the cost of your household electricity by applying a credit each month directly to your bill. You must be a customer of an electricity utility, and your household size and income must meet the program levels. The credit is bigger for some households, so ask when you apply.
What changed in 2024

Effective March 1, 2024 the Ontario government changed the household income amounts needed to qualify, which made more households eligible. Existing recipients may be eligible for higher credits and are asked to reapply. If you tried OESP before and were turned down, try again.
How to apply

Use the new application or renewal link on ontarioelectricitysupport.ca. You can also contact an intake agency near you for help. Indigenous households can get support by phone or at oesp@ishkoday.ca. The OESP contact centre is 1-855-831-8151, and the email is help@ontarioelectricitysupport.ca.
Free upgrades

The Energy Affordability Program is run through Save on Energy. The comprehensive support path covers households with income up to $48,220 for one person, $68,193 for two, $83,518 for three, $96,439 for four and $107,823 for five or more. People already on programs such as OESP, ODSP or Ontario Works can also qualify. Call 1-844-770-3148.
What we could not confirm
The OESP home page does not show a dollar credit table or a household income table, so we do not print a figure. Ask the contact centre for the amount for your household.
Pair them
OESP lowers each bill now. Free upgrades lower the bills that follow. If you heat with oil, ask about a cold-climate heat pump under the Energy Affordability Program.
Renters and landlords

OESP is tied to the electricity account, so tenants whose power is billed to them can apply. If your electricity is included in your rent, ask your landlord and the program whether another path exists. We did not read a rule on this, so we do not say.
Before you call

Have your latest hydro bill, your account number and your household income to hand. Write down how many people live in your home. Those three items decide most of what the contact centre will ask you.
Why two programs

OESP works on the bill, while the Energy Affordability Program works on the house. A tight, warm home needs less power, and a credit on a smaller bill goes further. Households that use both are usually better off than households that use one.
Scams
Neither program charges a fee to apply. If a caller asks for money, a gift card or your bank login to give you a credit, hang up and call the number printed on your hydro bill.

faq: The Ontario Electricity Support Program applies a monthly credit directly to the electricity bills of eligible lower-income households.
Yes. Effective March 1, 2024 the household income amounts needed to qualify changed, so more households are eligible. Existing recipients may be eligible for a higher credit if they reapply.
How do I apply for OESP?
Online at ontarioelectricitysupport.ca, with an intake agency, or by calling 1-855-831-8151.
Is there a free upgrade program too?
Yes. The Energy Affordability Program through Save on Energy gives free upgrades to income-qualified households.
